source: National Public Cadastral Map / EGKN WFS 2.0.0
sortBy: gid (ascending observed; `gid+A` is rejected as an illegal property name)
startIndexBehavior: startIndex increases by returned feature count; every cell paged to an empty terminal page; totalFeatures/numberMatched matched row totals.
duplicateConsistency: All repeated gids across cells had the same kad_nomer and identical geometry; no within-cell duplicate IDs.
geometryOutput: WFS source output was EPSG:32642; geometry reprojected for output from the coordinates returned by the source. No address/owner values are stored.
geometryHashBasis: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of source EPSG:32642 geometry; hash may change if source geometry changes.

topologyCheck.overlapMetricMethod: GEOS 3.14.1 on EPSG:32642 geometries; intersection area in m²; minimum-area rotated rectangle side lengths for each intersection and each parent parcel; percentages are intersection area divided by each parent parcel area.
topologyCheck.overlapAssessment: The two largest intersections are boundary slivers: 0.450998 m², minimum rotated envelope 0.009818 × 98.479806 m, 0.074380% of its smaller parcel; and 0.381905 m², envelope 0.012098 × 90.983847 m, 0.004978% of its smaller parcel. The remaining three intersections are each at most 0.006835 m². Accepted as explicit source-precision cases with unchanged geometry; no global topology tolerance or repair is introduced.
topologyCheck.metricReview: Relative percentages were recalculated from the same recorded EPSG:32642 intersection and parent areas; values from an earlier geographic-plane assessment are superseded.
